title: [Bug Fix] #249: Raise populated ErrorInfo for Subscription Billing failures
summary: Subscription Billing error handlers now raise the fully populated ErrorInfo object instead of plain-text errors, enabling interactive users to navigate to the offending record when document creation fails.
key_points: Changed DisplayOrLogErrorFromBillingTemplate and DisplayOrLogErrorFromBillingLine to raise Error(ErrorTextInfo) instead of Error(ErrorText)
ErrorInfo objects are now fully populated with client error type, message, RecordId, SystemId, and TableId for navigation links
Interactive users can now navigate to the record causing the error instead of receiving a dead-end error message
Added regression test to verify ErrorInfo is raised correctly for billing failures
Automated billing continues to log errors without raising interactive errors
